tables.name: users
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

tables.name: product_categories
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE product_categories (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_id INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES product_categories(id)
);
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_product_categories_name ON product_categories(name);

tables.name: products
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE products (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    brand TEXT,
    category_id INTEGER,
    is_prime_eligible INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_subscription_eligible INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES product_categories(id)
);

tables.name: product_versions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE product_versions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    format TEXT,
    is_digital INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_product_versions_type ON product_versions(version_type, format);

tables.name: product_offers
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE product_offers (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seller_id INTEGER,
    sku TEXT,
    price REAL NOT NULL,
    currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
    in_stock_quantity INTEGER,
    is_prime_eligible INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
);

tables.name: product_subscription_offers
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE product_subscription_offers (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    offer_name TEXT,
    min_interval_days INTEGER NOT NULL,
    max_interval_days INTEGER,
    discount_percent REAL,
    is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
);

tables.name: product_aggregates
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE product_aggregates (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    average_rating REAL,
    review_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    sales_rank INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
);

tables.name: user_addresses
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_addresses (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    label TEXT,
    line1 TEXT NOT NULL,
    line2 TEXT,
    city TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    postal_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    country TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'US',
    is_default_shipping INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_user_addresses_default_shipping ON user_addresses(user_id, is_default_shipping);

tables.name: user_payment_methods
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_payment_methods (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payment_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    card_last4 TEXT,
    card_brand TEXT,
    card_exp_month INTEGER,
    card_exp_year INTEGER,
    external_payment_ref TEXT,
    is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_user_payment_methods_default ON user_payment_methods(user_id, is_default);

tables.name: user_devices
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_devices (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    device_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT,
    is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_user_devices_default ON user_devices(user_id, device_type, is_default);

tables.name: carts
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE carts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_carts_user_active ON carts(user_id, status);

tables.name: cart_items
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE cart_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    cart_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_offer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (cart_id) REFERENCES carts(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_offer_id) REFERENCES product_offers(id)
);

tables.name: orders
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE orders (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    order_number TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    placed_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
    total_amount REAL NOT NULL,
    currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
    payment_method_id INTEGER,
    shipping_address_id INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (payment_method_id) REFERENCES user_payment_methods(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (shipping_address_id) REFERENCES user_addresses(id)
);

tables.name: order_items
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE order_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_offer_id INTEGER,
    product_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    is_digital INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_offer_id) REFERENCES product_offers(id)
);

tables.name: returns
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE returns (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    order_item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reason_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    refund_method TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    requested_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    processed_at DATETIME,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_item_id) REFERENCES order_items(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

tables.name: wishlists
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE wishlists (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_wishlists_user_name ON wishlists(user_id, name);

tables.name: wishlist_items
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE wishlist_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    wishlist_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (wishlist_id) REFERENCES wishlists(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id)
);

tables.name: user_subscriptions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_subscriptions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    subscription_offer_id INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    cadence_months INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cadence_months > 0),
    next_delivery_date DATETIME,
    shipping_address_id INTEGER,
    payment_method_id INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (subscription_offer_id) REFERENCES product_subscription_offers(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (shipping_address_id) REFERENCES user_addresses(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (payment_method_id) REFERENCES user_payment_methods(id)
);

tables.name: product_reviews
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE product_reviews (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_product_reviews_rating ON product_reviews(product_id, rating);

tables.name: users
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    full_name TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

tables.name: channels
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE channels (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    custom_url TEXT,
    description TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE(name)
);

tables.name: user_subscriptions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_subscriptions (
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    subscribed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, channel_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (channel_id) REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

tables.name: videos
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE videos (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('public','unlisted','private')),
    duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,
    published_at DATETIME,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (channel_id) REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_videos_channel_published ON videos(channel_id, published_at DESC);

tables.name: video_tags
user_liked_videos
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_liked_videos (
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    video_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    liked_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, video_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (video_id) REFERENCES videos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

tables.name: playlists
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE playlists (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('public','unlisted','private')),
    is_system INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_system IN (0,1)),
    system_type TEXT CHECK (system_type IN ('watch_later')),
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_playlists_user_name ON playlists(user_id, name);

tables.name: playlist_items
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE playlist_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    playlist_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    video_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    position INTEGER NOT NULL,
    added_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (playlist_id) REFERENCES playlists(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (video_id) REFERENCES videos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (playlist_id, video_id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_playlist_items_playlist_id_position ON playlist_items(playlist_id, position);

tables.name: comments
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE comments (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    video_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    parent_comment_id INTEGER,
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (video_id) REFERENCES videos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (parent_comment_id) REFERENCES comments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_comments_video_id_created_at ON comments(video_id, created_at);

tables.name: user_settings
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_settings (
    user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    default_playback_quality TEXT CHECK (default_playback_quality IN ('144p','240p','360p','480p','720p','1080p','1440p','2160p')),
    preferred_caption_language TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

tables.name: video_captions
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE video_captions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    video_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    language_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_auto_generated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_auto_generated IN (0,1)),
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (video_id) REFERENCES videos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (video_id, language_code, is_auto_generated)
);

tables.name: user_video_caption_prefs
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_video_caption_prefs (
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    video_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    language_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    use_auto_generated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (use_auto_generated IN (0,1)),
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, video_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (video_id) REFERENCES videos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

tables.name: user_watch_history
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_watch_history (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    video_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    watched_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    watch_duration_seconds INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (video_id) REFERENCES videos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_user_watch_history_user_watched_at ON user_watch_history(user_id, watched_at DESC);

tables.name: user_video_recommendations
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_video_recommendations (
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    video_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    score REAL NOT NULL,
    generated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, video_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (video_id) REFERENCES videos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_user_video_recommendations_user_score ON user_video_recommendations(user_id, score DESC);

tables.name: users
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  profile_data TEXT,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

tables.name: repositories
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE repositories (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  is_private INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  default_branch_id INTEGER,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(owner_id, name),
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (default_branch_id) REFERENCES branches(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_repositories_owner_name ON repositories(owner_id, name);

tables.name: branches
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE branches (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_protected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(repository_id, name),
  FOREIGN KEY (repository_id) REFERENCES repositories(id)
);

tables.name: tree_nodes
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE tree_nodes (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('file','directory')),
  content BLOB,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(branch_id, path),
  FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES branches(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_tree_nodes_branch_path ON tree_nodes(branch_id, path);

tables.name: pull_requests
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE pull_requests (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source_branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  target_branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  author_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK(status IN ('open','closed','merged')),
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (repository_id) REFERENCES repositories(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (source_branch_id) REFERENCES branches(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (target_branch_id) REFERENCES branches(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_pr_repo_status ON pull_requests(repository_id, status);

tables.name: pull_request_reviews
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE pull_request_reviews (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  pull_request_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  reviewer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('approved','changes_requested','commented')),
  body TEXT,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (pull_request_id) REFERENCES pull_requests(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

tables.name: pull_request_review_comments
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE pull_request_review_comments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  review_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pull_request_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  line_number INTEGER,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (review_id) REFERENCES pull_request_reviews(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (pull_request_id) REFERENCES pull_requests(id)
);

tables.name: issues
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE issues (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  author_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK(state IN ('open','closed')),
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (repository_id) REFERENCES repositories(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_issues_repo_state ON issues(repository_id, state);

tables.name: issue_task_items
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE issue_task_items (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  is_completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (issue_id) REFERENCES issues(id)
);

tables.name: labels
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE labels (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  color TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(repository_id, name),
  FOREIGN KEY (repository_id) REFERENCES repositories(id)
);

tables.name: issue_labels
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE issue_labels (
  issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  label_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (issue_id, label_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (issue_id) REFERENCES issues(id),

);

tables.name: workflows
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE workflows (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT,
  is_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

tables.name: workflow_triggers
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE workflow_triggers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  workflow_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event TEXT NOT NULL,
  branch_filter TEXT,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES workflows(id)
);

tables.name: workflow_required_status_checks
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE workflow_required_status_checks (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  workflow_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(workflow_id, branch_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (workflow_id) REFERENCES workflows(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES branches(id)
);

tables.name: dependabot_configs
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE dependabot_configs (

  repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(repository_id, path),
  FOREIGN KEY (repository_id) REFERENCES repositories(id)
);

tables.name: dependabot_updates
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE dependabot_updates (

  config_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  package_ecosystem TEXT NOT NULL,
  directory TEXT NOT NULL,

  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  FOREIGN KEY (config_id) REFERENCES dependabot_configs(id)
);

tables.name: github_pages_configs
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE github_pages_configs (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

tables.name: project_boards
tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE project_boards (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(repository_id, name),
